rule_name: At most 2 entries per day; after the second trade, whatever its outcome, no further trade.
calculation: number of entries today
why_it_matters: daily trade cap

rule_name: Initial range = high and low of the 09:15-09:20 five-minute candle, wicks included; final only after the candle closes at 09:20.

calculation: direction

rule_name: Price closes above IRH (breakout close).

required: a red candle plus a closing break of the level
